title: Is This Seat Taken?
genre: Cozy logic puzzle / seating-arrangement puzzler (place quirky passengers and guests according to their preferences)
release_date: 2025-08-07 (simultaneous: Steam/Windows, macOS, Linux, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android; Switch version shadow-dropped during a Nintendo Indie World Direct) [CONFIRMED – Gematsu / Pocket Tactics / Wikipedia]
window_note: In window (Aug 2025 release; still selling and featured by Apple in 2026).
developer: Poti Poti Studio (co-founders Sergi Pérez Crespo and Ausiàs Dalmau)
team_size: 2 core developers [CONFIRMED – Gamereactor interview; Mancunion review calls it 'a two-man studio']. Credits also list contributing writers and a composer [Thinky Games interview], so the core team is 2 plus freelancers.
country: Spain [ESTIMATE – listed in the Spanish devuego.es studio directory; the founders spoke at Spanish conferences (BIG Conference, Bilbao Games Conference); city not verified]
developer_background: First game [CONFIRMED – Gamereactor]. The duo decided to go indie in June 2024 after Ausiàs was laid off [CONFIRMED – Indie Arena Booth profile]. Sergi quit his job to go full-time on the project [CONFIRMED – Thinky Games interview]. They expected it to be a short learning project that would 'fail', until Wholesome Games picked up the pitch [CONFIRMED – Gamereactor].
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035120/Is_This_Seat_Taken/ ; iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6747814605 ; Switch: https://ec.nintendo.com/AU/en/titles/70010000100806 ; also Google Play, macOS, Linux
business_model: Premium $9.99 on all platforms (Steam, Switch, iOS, Android); regular discounts (e.g. -30% to $6.99 on Steam)
units_or_downloads: Steam: ~428,200 copies (range 283.4k–572.9k) [ESTIMATE – Gamalytic, snapshot date not shown, ~2026]; ~165,900–176,000 copies [ESTIMATE – Raijin, Jul–Oct 2026, medium confidence]. Boxleiter: 9,174 reviews × 30 (single-player cozy puzzler, engaged audience) ≈ 275,000 (×40 ≈ 367,000) [ESTIMATE]. Switch, iOS, Android: no data (no official sales figures published). No developer/publisher unit milestone found.
peak_concurrent_players: Steam: 1,301 all-time peak, Aug 2025 [ESTIMATE – SteamCharts]; 1,696 [ESTIMATE – Tracker.gg]; 984 [ESTIMATE – Raijin, as of 2026-07-22]. Low concurrent-player numbers are typical for a short, single-player puzzle game and do not reflect sales well.
steam_reviews: 9,174 reviews, 97% positive ('Overwhelmingly Positive') [aggregator, 2026]; 8,686 (Steambase snapshot); 9,079, 97% (Raijin). Early snapshot: 318 reviews, 99.4% positive on 2025-08-10 (Boiling Steam). Critics: Metacritic 84 (Switch) / 79 (PC); OpenCritic 90% recommend.
implied_review_multiplier: n/a (no confirmed unit figure). Tracker-implied: Gamalytic 428k ÷ ~9.1k ≈ 47×; Raijin ~170k ÷ ~9.1k ≈ 19×.
gross_revenue: Steam: ~$3.4M (range $2.2M–$4.5M) [ESTIMATE – Gamalytic]; ~$1.4M [ESTIMATE – Raijin, Oct 2026]. Boxleiter method: 275k–367k × ($9.99 × 0.75 ≈ $7.49) ≈ $2.1M–$2.7M [ESTIMATE]. Working figure: ~$1.4M–$3.4M Steam gross. Switch and mobile are additional and unknown.
net_revenue: [ESTIMATE] Steam gross $1.4M–$3.4M × 0.70 × 0.93 ≈ $0.9M–$2.2M to developer + publisher. The Poti Poti / Wholesome Games split is not disclosed. Switch (Nintendo 30%) and mobile (Apple/Google 15–30%) are not included.
production_cost: [ESTIMATE] 2 people × ~14 months (June 2024 → Aug 2025) × ~$6k/person-month (Spain, lean indie; arguably $4–6k) ≈ $110k–$170k, plus freelance writers/composer. The founders appear to have self-funded at first (one laid off, one quit his job), so much of this was opportunity cost. Wholesome Games publishing/marketing spend is unknown.
development_time: ~14 months from going indie (June 2024) to launch (2025-08-07); Next Fest demo after ~8 months (2025-02-10) [ESTIMATE – derived from Indie Arena profile + launch date]
why_popular: Instantly relatable social hook: everyone knows the awkwardness of choosing a seat next to strangers. Each puzzle is a tiny comedic scene (the loud talker, the smelly passenger, the couple). The rules are easy to read but layer into real logic puzzles, in short, bite-sized levels. Charming 2D art, cheap, and available everywhere on day one (Switch, mobile, PC). It suits short-form video and 'which seat would you pick?' engagement. [Qualitative from reviews: Mancunion, Bonus Action, The Sixth Axis, Thinky Games]
marketing_channels: Wholesome Games publishing label and Wholesome Direct-style showcases; Steam Next Fest demo (Feb 2025); shadow-drop in a Nintendo Indie World Direct (2025-08-07); Apple App Store editorial ('Games We Love' story; featured in Apple's 'Hello Developer' August 2026 developer spotlight); Gamescom 2025 Indie Arena Booth; conference talks. TikTok/short-form virality is plausible given the format but NOT verified by any source found.
art_style: Clean, colourful 2D cartoon illustration; grid-based seating layouts
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: code a grid-based constraint puzzle engine with a rule system for passenger preferences (adjacency, noise, smell, window seat), a level loader, an undo stack and a solver/validator to check level solvability (Claude Code); generate a consistent 2D character set and backgrounds (Scenario/Midjourney with a style reference, then hand cleanup); SFX (ElevenLabs) and cozy music (Suno); draft flavour text. | AI cannot: craft a satisfying difficulty curve and 'aha' moments across many levels (the real moat), create characters with humour and charm, polish UI/UX for touch and controller, secure a publisher or platform featuring (Wholesome, Nintendo Direct, Apple). | Toolset: Claude Code + Godot 4 (2D) or Unity, Scenario/Midjourney/Retro Diffusion for 2D art, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno music, Steamworks + mobile export. Score 5: 2D, single-player, one core loop; an MVP with ~20 levels is realistic in ≤4 weeks.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: [ESTIMATE – spec method] 3–5 weeks, $150–$400 (Claude Pro/Max, image gen, audio, $100 Steam Direct fee); excludes the developer's living costs
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: [ESTIMATE – spec method] 4–8 months, $2,000–$7,000 (subscriptions, freelance illustrator pass for a consistent character set, Apple $99/yr + Google $25, Switch port via a porting partner extra, playtest/marketing budget); excludes the developer's living costs

data_conflicts: Steam units: Gamalytic ~428k (283k–573k) vs Raijin ~166k–176k; the Boxleiter midpoint (~275k–367k) sits between them, so a range of ~170k–430k with ~300k as the central case is used. Gross: $1.4M (Raijin) vs $3.4M (Gamalytic). Peak CCU: 984 (Raijin) / 1,301 (SteamCharts) / 1,696 (Tracker.gg). Studio name appears as 'Poti Poti Studio' (Apple, Wikipedia) and 'Poti Poti Studios' (Gamereactor). Team: '2 people' refers to the co-founders; credits include freelance writers and a composer.
notes: Strong template for a solo or duo AI-assisted creator: a 2D puzzle game built on one universally relatable social situation, with low production scope, launched day-one on every platform at $9.99 with a cozy-focused publisher (Wholesome Games). Lower Steam concurrent players (~1–1.7k) but ~9k reviews at 97%: success came from broad multi-platform reach and platform featuring (Nintendo Indie World, Apple editorial), not friendslop-style streaming. The developers noted that post-launch promotion consumed all their time and delayed the next game. Viral TikTok spread is not verified; the game is better described as a 'breakout cozy hit' than a meme-viral hit.
